newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer sets research agreement.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer sets research agreement.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said on Thursday that it had agreed to sponsor up to $5 million in reaserch awards for scientists at Stanford Universtiy.

The agreement, which allows Stanford scientist to apply for research grants to gene therapy and drug discovery, also will involve collaboration with RPR's Gencell and gene therapy division, the company said in a statement.
Under the agreement, Stanford will own any technology it develops in projects with RPR, and the pharmaceutical company will receive a license to the technology.
The research will focus on treatments for cancer, cardiovascular disease and central nervous system disorders, the company said.
